newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank cuts rediscount rate for Jan.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank cuts rediscount rate for Jan.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had cut its rediscounting rate for the month of January to 10.679 percent from 10.7 percent.
The new rate is computed monthly and fixed at one percentage point below the average three-month Treasury bill rate in the last auction of the previous month, the statement said.
The rediscounting facility of the Philippine Central Bank is not meant as a tool to influence money supply. It is essentially a concessional lending window to help exporters and farmers.

Borrowings from the rediscounting window reached 8.547 billion pesos since the start of the year, the Central Bank said. Of this amount, 5.071 billion pesos went to export financing and the rest to the farm sector.
